h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panihati

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Panihati

c: Panihati is an old town on the Hooghly in North 24 Parganas, with riverside ghats, temples and a dense grid of homes and small factories. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Panihati for the municipality, schools, colleges, clubs and apartment complexes. Our machines are made at the Vasai factory, about 1650 km away, and sent to Bengal by road.

When the truck reaches Panihati, our installers or an eastern India dealer set up each machine. The riverside belt is humid most of the year and waterlogs easily in the monsoon. We set every machine on a raised concrete base with a slope, and galvanised frames handle the damp. Space is usually the tightest constraint, so we often suggest combination or double machines that do more on one footing.

richText.heading: Two machines that cover a lot of ground

items.q: Can two machines really make a useful outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes, if they are chosen well. A combination frame and a double machine together cover legs, waist and upper body for several users at once.

items.q: How do we keep a riverside gym dry in the monsoon?
items.a: Use the highest part of the site, build a raised concrete base and clear standing water and silt after heavy rain. Check bolts once the season ends.

items.q: Who installs outdoor gyms in Panihati?
items.a: Our own installation team or a dealer in eastern India. They fix the machines grouted or self-standing, as the ground allows, following your approved layout.
